en.hubeali: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazzaz, from Abu Baseer who said,
[17:85] And they are asking you about the Spirit. Say: The Spirit is from the Commands of my Lord.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘A creature more magnificent than Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> and Mikaeel<sup>as</sup>. It did not happen to be with anyone from the past apart from Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>, and it is with the Imams<sup>asws</sup>, protecting them<sup>asws</sup>
, and it isn’t so that everything what is sought, it found’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz from abu Basir who has said the following. “I heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say, ‘“They ask you about the Spirit. Say, “The Spirit comes by the command of my Lord. . .” [17:85]. The Imam (a.s.) said, “He is a creature greater than Jibril and Mika’il. He was present with anyone before except Muhammad (s.a.). He is present with the Imams (a.s.). He protects them. It is not that whatever is desired is found.”
